rules.statement: A deed executed by an incumbent of a Buddhist temple under the Sisiyanu Sisya Paramparawe tenure, purporting to donate property belonging to the temple to one of his junior pupils and providing for the latter's succession upon death, is intended to appoint that pupil as successor.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my view the words made use of by Guneratne Thero in D1 contain a plain intention to appoint the first defendant as successor to the incumbency."
